decisions.reason: Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL and original MethodDef MT.ADAE.TRTEMFL explicitly assign N otherwise; the probe retains that branch and the nonmissing TRTSDT condition. Its 65 N-versus-empty differences are reproduced by the reference comparison, and character-missing serialization cannot remove the documented nonmissing N.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM and workbook Methods row 55 both contain the literal 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS' equality and exact exclusion membership; the primary probe preserves these clauses. The 181 differences disappear only in the joined-SOC-text reading, while ADRG page-8 supplies no corrected SOC spelling and the physical-null readings also differ from the reference.

The full Define-XML ADAE.AEREL section and original MT.ADAE.AEREL at lines 4588-4592 state AE.AEREL, despite the finding's blank displayed quote. The specification reads that same AE.AEREL and only converts its missing representation to empty text; the source and reference values agree, so this is not a different copy source under CR-4.

The full Define-XML ADAE.AEACN section and original MT.ADAE.AEACN at lines 4518-4522 state AE.AEACN, despite the finding's blank displayed quote. The specification reads that same AE.AEACN and only converts its missing representation to empty text; the source and reference values agree, so this is not a different copy source under CR-4.

Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL, confirmed by MT.ADAE.TRTEMFL and workbook Methods row 64, explicitly assigns N in the otherwise branch. The executable TRTEMFL flag instead assigns empty text for false or missing conditions; retaining N in submission.method.description does not implement that branch.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM and workbook Methods row 55 literally spell the SOC 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS', while the executable CQ01NAM condition joins 'SUBCUTANEOUS'. This is a different equality constant even though the joined spelling is the reading that reproduces the reference.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM and workbook Methods row 55 exclude the three complete AEDECOD terms by membership. _DERM_EXCL uses an unanchored substring pattern and CQ01NAM tests its absence, which can exclude longer terms containing those strings and is therefore a different condition.

Original Define-XML IT.ADAE.STUDYID at lines 2059-2069 has Origin Type='Predecessor' with description ADSL.STUDYID, also present in workbook Variables row 42. The projected ADAE.STUDYID section omits that Origin, so absence of a Method or Comment does not establish an undocumented derivation; any AE-versus-ADSL source discrepancy is a separate question.

Original Define-XML IT.ADAE.USUBJID at lines 2077-2087 has Origin Type='Predecessor' with description ADSL.USUBJID, also present in workbook Variables row 44. The projected ADAE.USUBJID section omits that Origin, so absence of a Method or Comment does not establish an undocumented derivation; any AE-versus-ADSL source discrepancy is a separate question.

Define-XML ADAE.ASTDTF and workbook Methods row 53 state only the D assignment when the day is imputed, with no otherwise representation. Empty text reproduces the reference and physical null does not, but neither that comparison nor ADRG pages 5 and 28 supplies a documented empty-text branch.

Define-XML ADAE.AENDT and workbook Methods row 24 state conversion of AE.AEENDTC to a numeric SAS date without day imputation. The retained first-day imputation statements in ADAE.ASTDT and ADRG pages 5 and 28 apply to start dates, while the executable AENDT separately adds day: 1.

Define-XML ADAE.ADURU and ADRG page-29 require DAYS when ADURN is nonmissing, but give no otherwise representation. The page-27 and page-28 DAY/NA examples concern historical comparisons, and the empty-text versus physical-null probe comparison cannot supply the missing documentation for the executable branch.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL and workbook Methods row 49 specify 'within each Subject' using USUBJID and the stated SOC/PT keys, without adding STUDYID to the occurrence partition. ADRG page-8 states STUDYID as a record-linkage key, which does not state the additional grouping condition in _AOCCSEQ.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL and workbook Methods row 49 name ASTDT and AESEQ sort keys but give no missing-placement rule; no retained section supplies one. _AOCCSEQ explicitly places missing keys last, and equal results from the missing-first and missing-last probes on these records do not document that policy.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL and workbook Methods row 49 assign the first eligible record's flag but do not state an otherwise value or serialization. The original text-length-one Flag metadata supports Y as the populated token despite '?Y?', while reference agreement with empty text rather than physical null does not document AOCCFL's unassigned branch.

missed.quote:
ADAE contains one record per reported event per subject. Subjects who did not report any
Adverse Events are not represented in this dataset.
missed.reason: This event-level record scope and exclusion of subjects without reported adverse events is not quoted by a current finding or variable citation; the specification implements the record source at base: AE and has no rows rule or filter id.
